parakeet: Alright, so one of the biggest things I hear is that Christianity gives people hope. Why are you taking away people's hope? Well, the first thing about that is if Christianity indeed gave people hope, then why are there so many hopeless Christian communities? And the next thing is Christianity does not actually give people hope. After two decades being on the front lines, heavily involved in Christianity, what Christianity actually gives people is a dependency on a literary promise that was expected to be fulfilled over 2,000 years ago. By all definitions, that's not hope. That's a hope deferred. And for those of us who are poetically inclined, we already know the harmful consequences of such. Those are my few thoughts.
